decodedIntermediate.process: Browser Web Audio decodeAudioData in a 44100 Hz OfflineAudioContext; source STREAMINFO confirms native 44100 Hz mono PCM16. Exported to PCM16 without resampling or gain before this script.
decodedIntermediate.reproduction: Download the identified original FLAC. In a browser, decode its ArrayBuffer using new OfflineAudioContext(1, 24126, 44100).decodeAudioData(bytes). Write a standard 44-byte mono PCM16 WAV header and for each sample write Math.round(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,sample))*32767) as signed little-endian int16. The resulting file must match this intermediate SHA-256 before running this script; do not substitute an arbitrary decoder output silently.
